title: Hruday marginal locality: from coefficient decay to the reduced densities of the named constructions
selection_reason: BA1 admits boundary decay of the AM2 creation coefficients of the named constructions at q=1/64; the reduced density on R depends on the normalized outside state through straddling supports and the normalization, so coefficient decay is not state decay. BB1 closes that gap by two routes.
model: Zero-selected patterned family (AM2/AQ1), both signs |tau|<=10^-8; AM2 creation expansion in each on-site cutoff space; construction families F1 (AQ1 centered whole-star boxes) and F2 (I1 section 6 all-contained-face boxes with padding) on centered coarse cubes Lambda_N, N at least 2; reduced densities rho^{box}_Y of the normalized finite-box ground vectors on finite complete-factor regions Y, in particular the cover R={0,e_z}; trace norm on B(H_Y).

parameters.metric: coarse l-infinity metric on factor sites (star diameter 1), as admitted in BA1
parameters.weights: forward (polymer_kp): the BA1 diameter weight at w up to 1/(37888|tau|) and, for cardinality control, the mixed weight w^{diam I} e^{b|I|} with loss w e^{4b} per interaction (a new lemma, proved in full); reverse (iterated_split): the diameter weight with support sizes charged per site through |I| at most 8*2^{diam I}

region_form.form: ||rho^{box1}_Y-rho^{box2}_Y||_1 <= c_site |Y| e^{|Y|/10^8} q^{d_Y}, d_Y = N - max_{y in Y} |y|_inf

secondary.q: 151552|tau| (labelled secondary pair; the headline decides the loop)

rate_constant_pair.crude_tier_reported: crude_majorant tier reported separately, never a target
rate_constant_pair.floor_not_frozen: the BA1 per-step ratio 37888|tau| is not a target for reduced densities (both routes must spend part of the weight range)

comparisons: F1 on Lambda_N versus F1 on Lambda_{N+1}
F2 on Lambda_N versus F2 on Lambda_{N+1}
F1 versus F2 on the same Lambda_N
any two centered boxes Lambda_M, Lambda_M' with M, M' at least N, of F1 or F2 (compared directly, not by telescoping)
labelled: two finite complete-factor volumes of one prescription both containing Lambda_N, compared through their union
parameters.cutoff: each on-site cutoff space Q_L, every L, constants uniform in L; then, at fixed N, the untruncated ground vectors by the AV1 cutoff-vector removal (F20-F23); the N and L limits are never exchanged
parameters.clock: not applicable to static densities; the round clock is named in preregistration.clock
parameters.coefficient_input: the BA1 admitted coefficient differences, used at every site through a stated admitted form (forward boundary-weighted norm, or the reverse disc theorem restated for every site with its vanishing order)

required: 1. Write the exact AV1-type decomposition rho_Y = N_c(omega_O)/Tr N_c(omega_O) with omega_O the outside marginal on the straddle region; prove Tr N_c at least 1 (AV1 orthogonality) and the two Lipschitz bounds (in the coefficients and in omega_O), naming every constant with one tier and one route.

2. Forward (polymer_kp): derive the hard-core polymer representation of the norm (psi,psi) and the expectation (psi, A psi) (polymers are overlap-connected pairs of families of disjoint supports with the same excitation set), the activity bound |w(gamma)| at most the product of the creation norms, the Kotecky-Preiss condition with an explicit a, weights and tree majorant; prove the mixed-weight contraction lemma in full; use the real-parameter derivative along c+lambda(c'-c); never claim analyticity of the reduced density without a proved zero-free region.

3. Reverse (iterated_split): apply the AV1 product-ordering split recursively to the outside state, charging support sizes per site through the diameter weight, never the product of growing shell sizes; bound multi-support straddling families explicitly.

4. Use the BA1 coefficient differences at every site through a stated admitted form; prove the headline bound ||rho^{box1}_R-rho^{box2}_R||_1 <= C q^(N-1) with q=1/64 and C at most 1/250000 and the region form with c_site at most 1/500000 for every comparison, both signs, in each on-site cutoff space and at fixed N for the untruncated vectors; report the labelled secondary pair and the crude tier separately; never use the global Lipschitz constant as a decay factor.

5. Exhibit exactly the finite fixtures named by the fixture controls (coefficient decay is not marginal decay; second-order propagation; normalization coupling including a global-fidelity fixture; straddling supports; split-route trace and Lipschitz checks; polymer identity and cardinality factor; cutoff-limit order), each labelled model_is_finite_graph:true and transfers_to_aq:false; quote the mandatory sentence template once as one unbroken span; export the gate fields.
6. Declare and check the tau -> tau/100 scaling of every headline constant against its preregistered bracket; every control executed as a damaging mutation.
claim_exclusions: whole-sequence convergence or a common limit (BB2)
uniqueness of every infinite-volume ground state
boundary conditions outside the named constructions
analyticity of the reduced density in the coupling
any estimate uniform in the lattice spacing a
direction_note: Forward: polymer representation with a Kotecky-Preiss condition and a mixed-weight contraction lemma. Reverse: the AV1 product-ordering split applied recursively with per-site charging. Independence is limited to route and code; both use the admitted BA1 constants.

acceptance.accepted_within_scope: Both routes prove the headline and region bounds for every comparison, both signs, with each proved constant at most its frozen target.
acceptance.limited: Only the R form is proved (no region form), or only the near-support part with no control of far supports, or only one comparison.
acceptance.insufficient: Neither route controls the outside-state dependence; BA1's coefficient decay still stands, labelled as such.

new_control_semantics.topology_named: (R32) Trace norm on B(H_Y) for states, norm on compact theta windows for dynamics, GNS strong for representations; a fixed-vector versus moving-vector fixture is included.
new_control_semantics.common_clock: (R32) Both families and all comparisons use the same coupling and theta=alpha t/hbar.
new_control_semantics.normalization_couples_supports: The dependence of rho_R on the normalized outside state (straddling contractions, pair terms, sigma, d^2/n^2) is bounded explicitly; dropping it or normalizing by 1+O(t^2) without the product split is rejected.
new_control_semantics.outside_vector_not_ground_state: phi_out is the restriction of the box's coefficient family, not a ground state of an outside Hamiltonian; any gap argument applied to it is rejected.
new_control_semantics.global_fidelity_orthogonality_catastroph: Any bound through the global overlap of psi^N and psi^{N+1} (exponentially small in the shell) is rejected by a product-state fixture.
new_control_semantics.marginal_locality_constants_explicit: eta, kappa_0 and w' of the marginal-locality lemma are exact; a Kotecky-Preiss criterion asserted without activity bounds and combinatorial counts is rejected.
new_control_semantics.cutoff_uniform_then_removed: Cauchy bounds hold uniformly in the on-site cutoff L, then pass L->infinity at fixed N via AV1 F20-F23 (Eckart, untruncated gap 1/2); reversing the limits is rejected.
new_control_semantics.cutoff_vector_removal: (R32) The ground vector, not only eigenvalues, converges as the on-site cutoff is removed before any density bound is passed.
new_control_semantics.region_constant_scales_with_Y: Bounds on regions Y state the |Y|-dependence and the exponent d(Y,B_N); a constant proved for R and reused on Y is rejected.
new_control_semantics.named_construction_not_uniqueness: Convergence and a common limit of F1 and F2 (or of a pre-frozen AM2-admissible class) are never called uniqueness of every infinite-volume ground state, 'the thermodynamic limit' or 'the infinite-volume ground state'.
new_control_semantics.fixture_second_order_propagation: A chain fixture where a change two supports away from R moves the R-marginal exactly at the order of the product of the two straddling amplitudes (verified as an exact polynomial); first-order propagation claims or a per-link factor below the exact one are rejected.
new_control_semantics.fixture_split_lipschitz_and_trace: Tr N_c(omega) >= 1 and ||rho(omega)-rho(omega')||_1 <= 2||N(omega-omega')||_1 are checked exactly on a mixed outside state; a split bound that charges the product of growing region sizes (increasing with depth) is rejected in favour of per-site charging.
new_control_semantics.fixture_polymer_identity: Brute-force (psi,psi) on a four-site collection equals the polymer sum; pairing families with different excitation sets gives zero; dropping the cardinality factor in the tree majorant underestimates the cluster sum and is rejected.
new_control_semantics.zero_free_region_required: Any statement of analyticity of the reduced density in the coupling without a proved zero-free region of the complexified normalization is rejected.
new_control_semantics.every_site_coefficient_input: The BA1 coefficient differences are used at every site (not only on R) through a stated admitted form (the forward boundary-weighted norm, or the reverse disc theorem restated for every u with its vanishing order); an R-only input used at far sites is rejected.
new_control_semantics.mixed_weight_lemma_proved: The contraction with the mixed weight w^{diam I} e^{b|I|} (loss w e^{4b} per interaction) is proved in full before it is used; citing BA1 for it is rejected.
new_control_semantics.cutoff_limit_order: Bounds hold in each on-site cutoff space uniformly in the cutoff and pass to the untruncated vectors at fixed N; swapping the N and cutoff limits is rejected.

statements about boundary conditions outside the named constructions

observable.id: ||rho^{box1}_Y-rho^{box2}_Y||_1 on B(H_Y), Y=R and finite complete-factor regions

preregistration.error_terms_rule: an entry may be not_applicable only with a stated reason

target.quantity: C at q=1/64 (R form) and c_site at q=1/64 (region form)
target.note: blind discriminating threshold for a new estimate; margins of at least 2 against the advisor-recorded previews (not a producer premise)

preregistration.mandatory_sentence_template: For the zero-selected patterned family at the same coupling |tau|<=10^-8, and for every comparison of the named construction families F1 and F2 on centered coarse cubes, the reduced densities of the finite-box ground vectors on the cover R differ by at most C q^(N-1) in trace norm, in each on-site cutoff space and, at fixed N, for the untruncated ground vectors, where N is the smaller box size; this is locality of the reduced densities of the named constructions at a rate in N, not uniqueness of any ground state, not a statement about other boundary conditions, and not a statement uniform in the lattice spacing a.

gate_fields_required.state_decay_scope: reduced densities of F1/F2 finite-box ground vectors on R and on regions Y, per comparison

forbidden_phrasings: uniqueness of the infinite-volume ground state

scaling_brackets_per_constant.C_headline: [95,105] (linear in tau with a positive nonlinear correction)
